native_tests.scope: 17 focused native cases across approved Editor builds; final shield path rerun after fracture update

exact_editor_build.head: 86ccd04faede1a1aa93da9facb139e041cfeb0cd
exact_editor_build.notes: Final incremental compile/link used the559-sample/15-path header and updated reproducible baker. A subsequent Python-only probe revision uses public procedural geometry inspection and was syntax-verified; every compiled native candidate remains byte-identical to the final successful build. Fresh31-file hashes match the latest scope. The earlier cold399-sample build is retained as historical evidence only. No isolated runtime rendering is claimed.

limitations: Position-only PIE dodging and review camera preserve the observer; this is not a balance/skill test.
Boss readiness timestamps isolate real wizard rain and summon; native attack states and fuse durations remain unchanged.
Held primary Pickaxe input tests killing a summon; no Python damage or native attack helper is called.
No network, full battle, build, cook, package, saved content, shield or Knight validation here.

fixture_tuning.equipment_profile_read_source: Public MCInventoryComponent.Profile; native BeginPlay loads this into its private Settings cache, with the same 40 damage fallback
fixture_tuning.reason: Initial durability and position-only staging keep the short visual clip readable; subsequent health loss is real held-primary damage

limitations: Natural F3 rain and boss entrance precede the clips; position-only dodging protects the observer.
The shield starts with four base Pickaxe hits of durability as an explicit PIE preview fixture; native default 500 is covered separately.
Both boss walking speeds and unrelated readiness clocks are isolated only in PIE; boss/projectile damage and player health stay native.
Held primary input damages the shield; no Python damage resolver or attack helper is invoked.
Crack component/clock telemetry must be paired with inspection of the genuine rendered footage.
No content saves, network, complete battle, build, cook or package.

visual_review.fracture: PASS: actual healthy, 25%, 75%, and shatter frames inspected; uneven dark fissures and shell debris
visual_review.fire: PASS: actual player-sized burning nut, directional trail and impact inspected
visual_review.scope: Local visual QA of the short fixtures, not a full-battle balance review

video_timing: Separate actual game-time windows; every written source frame is retained with its timestamp. No temporal interpolation or time scaling.
missing_capture_policy: Missing screenshot requests are listed, not filled with invented frames. Real intervals across missing requests are preserved.
